rows.value: Traveller allowances (17 or older): 1 litre of spirits, 4 litres of wine, 16 litres of beer or cider, 200 cigarettes or 250 g of other tobacco, 50 ml of e-liquid; other goods £390 by commercial transport, £270 by private transport.
